 P.A. to Judge  A. MUHAMED MUSTAQUE, J.
 -----------------------------------------
 W.P.(C). No.19875 of 2014  -------------------------------------
 Dated this the 4th day of August 2014  J U D G M E N T
The vehicle belonging to the petitioner bearing registration No.KL-07-BY-9305 was taken into custody by the 2nd respondent.
His vehicle has been seized on the allegation that the water which was transporting the vehicle was contaminated and not fit for human consumption.

The portability of such water or other non-compliance of any regulations under the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 is a matter to be decided by the appropriate competent authority but that does not mean that the vehicle belonging to the petitioner shall be detained for a decision on the nature of water that was transported.
That being so, the respondents shall release the vehicle to the petitioner on executing a simple bond after taking necessary samples from the vehicle.
This writ petition is disposed of as above.
